plugin.note: Complete Death to the Dorgeshuun, then bring a Slayer bell, a light source and a rope to descend into the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (near fairy ring AJQ). Ring the Slayer bell within 3 tiles of a wall-attached Molanisk to lure it off, then kill it with crush melee (they have the lowest defence against crush). They hit only up to 5, so a mid-level player in decent armour can kill several safely. The 60% earth weakness makes earth spells a strong Magic alternative, and certain rocks (notably south of the AJQ fairy ring) can be used to safespot.

mechanics: Only Vannaka assigns Molanisks in this dataset (40-50, weighting 7); verified against Vannaka's raw task table on 2026-07-03.
Chaeldar and Duradel formerly assigned Molanisks but no longer do (Duradel removed 10 September 2015; Chaeldar removed 8 May 2024).
Requires 39 Slayer, combat level 50, and completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun; the task infobox id 10997 is used as slayerTargetId.
A Slayer bell is required to lure each Molanisk off the cave wall before it can be attacked; requiredItemId 10952 is Slayer bell (wiki item infobox id).
Molanisk has 52 Hitpoints, max hit 5 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 50 (stab 45, slash 45, crush 35, magic 30, ranged 55).
60% earth elemental weakness (Summer Sweep Up: Combat, 25 June 2025); weakness.style is MELEE (crush is lowest melee defence) with element 'earth' recorded for a Magic alternative.
No task extension unlock exists for Molanisks.

methods.label: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
steps: Around 10 Molanisks spawn in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (near fairy ring AJQ).
Entry to the dungeon requires completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun and a rope to climb down; a light source is required.
Safespottable on certain rocks, notably the large rock down the path south of the AJQ fairy ring.
A spot south of the fairy ring has two spawns close together for faster kills.
